name: Mae Ngat Reservoir
story: The raft cook has lost a tin cup. Look for the rings around its floating lid.

name: Chao Phraya River
story: The night ferry is one lantern short. A blue claw keeps tugging at its wick.

name: Cheow Lan Lake
story: A raft keeper sends a paper boat around the karst towers. Follow its wake.

name: Mekong at Nong Khai
story: A round print appears on the Moonbank. Wait for the bridge lights to reach it.

name: Salween River
story: A weaver knots a blue thread at the waterline. Fish before the thread goes under.

name: Pai River
story: Someone has left a flute on the ferry. Its lowest note brings a ripple to the bend.

name: Yuam River
story: A bamboo basket bumps the hull from below. Find out what is pushing it.

name: Moei River
story: Two boatmen exchange painted stones. Follow the red one's reflection.

name: Mae Lamao Creek
story: A leaf boat vanishes behind a root and comes back facing upstream.

name: Ing River
story: A child draws a ripple in wet clay. Complete the missing ring with your float.

name: Loei River
story: A potter's bell skips one note every time a shadow crosses the ford.

name: Huai Mong River
story: A loose spool unwinds from an empty skiff. Reel in time with it.

name: Huai Luang River
story: A reed whistle turns against the breeze. Cast beside its crooked stem.

name: Songkhram River
story: A loose plank knocks twice beneath a floating kitchen. Listen for a third knock.

name: Nam Kam River
story: A basket maker counts ripples in pairs. The odd one out belongs in your journal.

name: Nam Phung River
story: A wax candle bobs around a submerged branch. Fish its quiet side.

name: Kwan Phayao
story: A market painter has run out of silver. Bring her a scale to sketch.

name: Nong Han Lake, Sakon Nakhon
story: A folded parasol drifts past. The boatman wants to know what follows it.

name: Huai Luang Reservoir
story: An empty water jar hums like a drum. Its echo marks a deep shelf.

name: Nam Un Reservoir
story: A cloth map has one wet corner. Cast where its four folds meet.

name: Nam Phung Reservoir
story: The lantern tender bets that a still float can outrun a moving shadow.

name: Kok River
story: A brass bracelet catches sunlight below the ferry. A fish guards the glint.

name: Lao River
story: The last boat carries three green baskets. One has left a trail of bubbles.

name: Nong Luang Lake, Chiang Rai
story: A heron stands on yesterday's footprint. Something stirs in the hollow.

name: Chi River
story: A letter arrives folded into a carp. Find the fish with the same silhouette.

name: Phrom River
story: A bridge worker lowers a plumb line. Yours is the first line to twitch.

name: Choen River
story: A rain drum rolls off the landing. A fish answers its underwater beat.

name: Phong River
story: A knotted reed points across the flow. Try the seam just beyond it.

name: Lam Pao River
story: A grain seller paints a stripe on her paddle for every fish you land.

name: Yang River
story: A bright seed circles a snag three times. Time your cast to its return.

name: Chulabhorn Reservoir
story: A surveyor has a blank corner on his sounding chart. Fill it with a catch.

name: Ubol Ratana Reservoir
story: A cook times the rice by the float. Can you land a fish before supper?

name: Lam Pao Reservoir
story: An old oar bears a carved fin. Search for its living twin.

name: Prong Khun Phet Reservoir
story: A bottle with a cork of red clay drifts in. Something taps it from below.

name: Nong Han Kumphawapi
story: A lotus seller ties one ribbon below the petals. Fish within sight of the knot.

name: Kaeng Lawa
story: A reed mat floats free of its pegs. A little school takes shelter underneath.

name: Bueng Lahan
story: A bird drops a silver feather. Your float is the next thing to disappear.

name: Mun River
story: Two ferries cross and leave a patch of still water between their wakes.

name: Lam Takhong River
story: A musician hangs a bell from the bridge and promises a song for the first strike.

name: Lam Phra Phloeng River
story: A lantern goes out in the rain. Its reflection stays for one beat longer.

name: Lam Mun Bon River
story: A floating mango changes direction without touching the bank. Follow it.

name: Lam Plai Mat River
story: A blue scrap of cloth marks a split in the current. Pick the quieter branch.

name: Huai Samran River
story: A ferryman's chalk mark washes away every noon. Make a catch before it fades.

name: Lam Se Bok River
story: A tailor wants to sew a river onto a sleeve. Bring back the shape of a fin.

name: Lam Sebai River
story: A clump of floating grass shivers while the air is still. Cast along its rim.

name: Lam Dom Yai River
story: A paddle maker hears a deep thump under a hollow log. Lower the bait gently.

name: Sirindhorn Reservoir
story: A string of paper stars hangs from a raft. The lowest one grazes the water.

name: Lam Takhong Reservoir
story: A watchmaker sets his second hand to the little waves against the pier.

name: Lam Phra Phloeng Reservoir
story: The boat's red paint flakes onto the surface. A silver mouth takes the first fleck.

name: Lam Sae Reservoir
story: A girl names every cloud but one. The nameless cloud looks just like a fish.

name: Lam Plai Mat Reservoir
story: A tin roof ticks in the morning mist. Match its slow rhythm with the reel.

name: Lam Nang Rong Reservoir
story: A pilot leaves a cork beside the old channel. It describes a widening circle.

name: Ping River
story: The tea stall has a drawing of a missing float. Its orange tip is just downstream.

name: Mae Taeng River
story: Two bamboo poles frame a narrow chute. Drift a cast through the opening.

name: Mae Chaem River
story: A basket of limes breaks loose. One lime returns upriver on a hidden wake.

name: Mae Tuen River
story: A traveller marks her route in charcoal. Give her one more pool to draw.

name: Bhumibol Reservoir
story: A long echo returns from shore. The second echo is a fish breaking the surface.

name: Mae Kuang Reservoir
story: A shutter swings on the boathouse. Cast each time it turns gold in the light.

name: Wang River
story: A carved wooden horse sits on the landing. Its shadow points to the deep bend.

name: Mae Chang River
story: A child sails a seedpod downstream and asks you to beat it to the crossing.

name: Kio Lom Reservoir
story: A bamboo window frames a patch of water where the wind seems to stop.

name: Kio Kho Ma Reservoir
story: A boatbuilder balances an egg on a board. Only a heavy wake will roll it.

name: Mae Chang Reservoir
story: A tin of old hooks rattles at the bow. The quietest hook is yours today.

name: Yom River
story: An umbrella turns inside out on the bank. A tail splashes inside its reflection.

name: Ngao River
story: A smooth stone bears a white stripe. Fish where the stripe points at sunset.

name: Mae Ta River
story: A string of seed bells brushes the current. The largest bell suddenly falls silent.

name: Mae Mok River
story: A narrow wake draws an arrow through the reeds. Follow the arrowhead.

name: Mae Ramphan River
story: A baker dusts flour off her apron. The first ripple reaches your boat.

name: Nan River
story: A longboat painter leaves an eye unfinished. Land a fish to choose its colour.

name: Wa River
story: A waterlogged branch makes a small standing wave. A fin holds just behind it.

name: Sirikit Reservoir
story: The night watch trades a matchbox for the story of your heaviest catch.

name: Khwae Noi Bamrung Daen Reservoir
story: A guide has wound her sounding rope backward. Find the shelf with a cast.

name: Bueng Si Fai
story: A floating seed head sinks petal by petal. Set the hook on the last dip.

name: Noi River
story: The bell at the rice landing rings without a boat. Look beneath the first piling.

name: Lop Buri River
story: A brass ladle falls from the lunch boat. Three bubbles mark where it lands.

name: Bueng Boraphet
story: A notebook sketch shows one fish among a hundred reeds. Find its hiding place.

name: Sakae Krang River
story: A raft family sets an extra cup for the angler who can read a quiet float.

name: Thap Salao Reservoir
story: A broken kite floats beside the boat. A shadow keeps the paper wings open.

name: Pa Sak River
story: A rope ferry parts the drifting leaves. Fish the clear lane it leaves behind.

name: Lam Sonthi River
story: The last page of a field diary has room for one outline. Choose it carefully.

name: Muak Lek Stream
story: A cool spring lifts a fallen blossom. Watch for the float that moves the other way.

name: Pa Sak Jolasid Reservoir
story: A railway passenger drops a folded wish. A boatman challenges you to fish its wake.

name: Tha Chin River
story: A market basket leaks a trail of rice. A dark fin gathers the last grains.

name: Krasiao Reservoir
story: A retired ferryman counts waves instead of hours. His seventh wave carries a bite.

name: Mae Klong River
story: A line of lamps appears twice in the water. A broad back breaks the second line.

name: Khwae Yai River
story: An empty canteen knocks against a mooring. Cast when the knocking falls quiet.

name: Srinagarind Reservoir
story: An old raft book records a fish by the width of a hand. Try to redraw it to scale.

name: Vajiralongkorn Reservoir
story: A fisherman folds his map into a fan. The crease marks a promising hollow.

name: Nakhon Nayok River
story: A figure cut from banana leaf spins in a back eddy. Reel before it breaks free.

name: Khun Dan Prakan Chon Reservoir
story: A photographer waits for a ripple to split the reflection. Your float goes first.

name: Bang Phra Reservoir
story: The dawn shift leaves a cup on a rock. Its handle frames your casting mark.

name: Dok Krai Reservoir
story: A boat repairer hangs a painted float out to dry. Its twin is moving offshore.

name: Nong Pla Lai Reservoir
story: A long green ribbon comes loose from the landing. A fish keeps pace with its tip.

name: Kaeng Krachan Reservoir
story: A raft lantern casts two shadows. Only one belongs to the rope.

name: Pran Buri Reservoir
story: A little wooden ladder ends above the water. A school gathers beneath its lowest rung.

name: Bang Lang Reservoir
story: A storyteller stops mid-sentence when the float tilts. Land the ending.

name: Trat coastal waters
story: A shrimp boat trails three warm lamps. Something silver circles the last light.

name: Chanthaburi coastal waters
story: An oyster farmer lends you a blue cork. It bobs beyond the final raft.

name: Rayong coastal waters
story: A squid lamp paints the wake green. A needle-shaped fish cuts through the glow.

name: Chon Buri coastal waters
story: A deckhand chalks a starting line beside the reel. Race the falling tide.

name: Samut Prakan coastal waters
story: A harbour pilot folds a flag as a shoal flashes beside the buoy.

name: Samut Sakhon coastal waters
story: An ice boat leaves frost on the rail. Your first strike shakes it loose.

name: Samut Songkhram coastal waters
story: A white shell clicks against the anchor chain. A second click comes from the line.

name: Phetchaburi coastal waters
story: A salt worker shades her eyes and points to a blue seam beyond the shallows.

name: Prachuap Khiri Khan coastal waters
story: A squid jig comes back with a scrap of red thread. Find the wake that carried it.

name: Chumphon coastal waters
story: A skipper marks the thermos with chalk for each fish before the coffee cools.

name: Surat Thani coastal waters
story: A coconut rolls to port on a flat sea. Something large is lifting the starboard line.

name: Nakhon Si Thammarat coastal waters
story: A rattle of shells runs down the gunwale. The tide brings a second rhythm.

name: Songkhla coastal waters
story: A night pilot recognizes his boat by its whistle. Recognize your catch by its pull.

name: Pattani coastal waters
story: Fresh paint on the prow reflects in four colours. A school splits them into sparks.

name: Narathiwat coastal waters
story: The watchman lifts a blue lantern when he sees the first feeding birds.

name: Ranong coastal waters
story: Rain blurs the island outlines. A ringing cleat helps you feel the strike.

name: Phang Nga coastal waters
story: A deckhand wraps the bait tin in yellow cloth. The sea returns a flash of gold.

name: Phuket coastal waters
story: A rope splicer wagers a coil of cord on the fish that outruns the boat.

name: Krabi coastal waters
story: A limestone silhouette disappears into mist. Your reel sings from the clear side.

name: Trang coastal waters
story: A sailmaker's palm lies by the tiller. The strongest run leaves its imprint in salt.

name: Satun coastal waters
story: The logbook's final page smells of tar. A broad silver tail gives it a closing line.
